new_results.name: QFORM-EXACT-COLOOP-AGGREGATE-HALFRIESZ-v1
new_results.statement: Inside the r32 exact angular packet, if a physical right-bank row has leverage eta_j=1, the complementary row frame is exactly one-dimensional. Aggregating that disjoint product bank and choosing the larger of the orthogonal square coefficients h_j,h_c yields ||p_Q||_infinity <=2^(13/4)e^(3/4)s_3(A)^(-1), including h_j=0. Essential boundedness and linear small-ball scaling are proved; continuity is not.

new_results.name: QFORM-SCALAR-BILINEAR-DECOUPLED-TIME-v1
new_results.statement: For R=S(B)+2bU(B)Y with Y independent of the whole background, p_Y<=M_Y and the marginal density of U bounded by M_U, |phi_R(t)|^2<=min(1,pi M_U M_Y/(|b||t|)) and int |t|^(-1/2)|phi_R(t)|^2dt <=8sqrt(pi M_U M_Y/|b|), without splitting conjugate sums/differences.

new_results.name: QFORM-HEAVY-ROW-SCALAR-SCHUR-HALFRIESZ-v1
new_results.statement: For any physical right-bank row of leverage c>0 with nonzero physical coefficient h_r in the exact one-sided packet, exact pair coordinates show the weak complement projection cancels after the genuine physical square pivot. The residual is one scalar bilinear product, giving ||p_Q||_infinity <=4sqrt(2e) sqrt(|a|/(|sigma|m sqrt(c)|h_r|)) and the corresponding weighted independent-copy time bound.

next_step: Treat 2/3<c<1 in the joint limit c->1 and h_r->0. Retain the weak complementary direction of energy 1-c and interpolate between the stable pair-cap/Fresnel half-Riesz theorem and the exact-coloop aggregate square pivot; do not drop that weak term or assign it a false conditional cap.
